patterns.title: Compare a named test condition before numeric comparison
patterns.admission_basis: Both frozen declared synthetic gates passed in deterministic receipt replay.

D12.reason: The factual condition statements establish an earlier original feature list and a later addition of two input features. The quoted imperative is instruction-like text, not a factual statement about the feature-set condition, so it does not establish conflicting condition evidence.

C07.reason: The named dimension is polarizer orientation. Both excerpts establish only that a polarizer was present; neither states its orientation. The reviewer reasoned about presence rather than the named dimension.
